content.text:
Built a complete, playable **Block & Beam** game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.

It includes Tetris-style block placement, line clears, score and level tracking, keyboard and touch controls, pause and retry, sound toggle, saved best score, and a voxel-style house that develops as you clear lines. It’s responsive for mobile and desktop.

Verified the game starts and responds to movement, rotation, and hard drop; checked the browser console for errors and inspected the latest mobile screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

**Assumption:** “Minecraft house” means an original, cozy voxel-inspired house—not Minecraft assets or an exact recreation.
